title: SalesOps - Consultant, Technical Transformation - Customer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
 The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology\-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Consultant or equivalent
   

  

 As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high\-quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
* Translate Sales Operations requirements into scalable technology solutions supporting:
+ Territory and account alignment
+ Segmentation and targeting
+ Quota and incentive planning
+ Sales forecasting
+ Pipeline and opportunity management
+ Account planning and field productivity
+ Pricing, quoting, and approvals
+ Commercial performance reporting

* Design solutions that can integrate with multiple CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, and analytics platforms.
* Configure or implement solutions across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and other enterprise applications.
* Develop reusable integration patterns, APIs, data models, workflows, and accelerators that can be deployed across client environments.
* Identify and implement practical Agentic AI use cases, including:
+ Sales planning assistants
+ Forecasting and pipeline analysis agents
+ Next\-best\-action recommendations
+ Account and territory intelligence
+ Automated opportunity and CRM hygiene
+ Quoting and approval support
+ Sales performance insights

* Define appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop controls, access controls, auditability, evaluation criteria, and escalation paths for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops, process assessments, design sessions, demonstrations, and user acceptance testing.
* Partner with business stakeholders, commercial leaders, IT teams, data scientists, architects, and implementation teams.
* Establish solution roadmaps, implementation plans, adoption strategies, and measurable value cases.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including proposals, solution demonstrations, estimates, and client presentations.
* Ensure solutions reflect life sciences\-specific requirements related to HCP/HCO data, field force structures, regulatory expectations, data privacy, and commercial compliance.


**The team:**
 Step into our
 **Sales \& Service** 
 team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end\-to\-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back\-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* 3 \- 6 years of hands\-on experience in Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, CRM, CPQ, business transformation, or technology implementation.
* Strong understanding of Sales Operations processes and performance drivers.
* Experience implementing or integrating two or more CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, or analytics platforms.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data integration, workflow automation, and enterprise solution architecture.
* Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool calling, or AI orchestration.
* Ability to convert business requirements into functional designs, technical specifications, and implementation plans.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, SAP CPQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare commercial operations.
* Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and low\-code/no\-code automation platforms.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent monitoring, and responsible AI practices.
* Consulting, systems integration, product management, or enterprise architecture experience.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent from accredited university


**Location:**
* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Senior Manager, Product Management
description:
The Product Management function defines the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for platforms and capabilities that deliver customer value and enable business outcomes. By partnering closely with engineering, design, data, operations, and business teams, the function drives outcome focused product discovery and delivery, balances innovation with platform stability, and ensures disciplined prioritization and governance. The team applies modern product management practices, customer centric thinking, and data informed decision making to deliver scalable, high impact products across the enterprise.
   

  





 The Senior Manager, Product Management builds and executes the product management strategy for assigned digital platforms and products, or business domains, aligning product vision, roadmaps, prioritization, and governance frameworks with business priorities and customer needs. The role enables predictable, high quality digital product outcomes by overseeing end to end product lifecycle execution, and by building strong product management capability aligned to organizational product standards and outcome driven practices.
   

  





**Strategic Responsibilities** 
  





 · Build and execute the product management strategy for assigned platforms, products, or domains by aligning product vision, roadmaps, OKRs, and prioritization with business goals, customer outcomes, and governance frameworks.
   





 · Implement product governance and outcome controls by operationalizing product management processes, portfolio reviews, prioritization frameworks, success metrics, and documentation standards.
   





 · Promote product practice uplifting by identifying gaps in product discovery, delivery, and lifecycle practices and adopting modern product management methods and tools.
   





 · Optimize product planning and delivery by aligning road mapping, prioritization cycles, dependency management, and resource allocation across PM teams to improve predictability and value delivery.
   





 · Monitor product, delivery, and portfolio risks, establish escalation paths, and support informed trade off decisions across scope, customer impact, stability, timelines, and priorities.
   





**Functional Responsibilities** 
  





 · Oversee end to end product lifecycle execution across assigned platforms, products, or business areas, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer needs, and product strategy.
   





 · Ensure consistent application of product governance practices across teams, including prioritization frameworks, roadmap hygiene, outcome metrics, documentation standards, and decision making rigor.
   





 · Align product priorities, roadmap decisions, and dependency management with engineering, design, data, operations, and business partners to deliver integrated, scalable product outcomes.
   





 · Strengthen product delivery workflows through standardization of discovery practices, roadmapping approaches, prioritization templates, OKR adoption, and product tooling to improve consistency and predictability.
   





 · Assure predictable portfolio level outcomes by monitoring product performance, delivery health, dependency risks, platform stability, and execution bottlenecks across initiatives.
   





**People Responsibilities** 
  





 · Lead and guide multiple Product Managers and Product Management leads across assigned platforms, products, or domains, strengthening product discipline, customer focus, and outcome oriented execution.
   





 · Build strong relationships with senior business, engineering, design, data, and platform leaders to ensure transparency, aligned priorities, and effective portfolio level decision making.
   





 · Identify capability gaps within product teams and drive targeted capability building initiatives across product strategy, discovery, prioritization, stakeholder management, and outcome ownership.
   





 · Support hiring and onboarding of Product Managers by contributing to role definitions, skill requirements, candidate assessment, and effective team integration.
   





 · Provide ongoing performance feedback, coaching, and career guidance to Product Managers to develop high potential talent and build a strong product leadership pipeline.
   

  

  

  

  




 Requirements
   

  


 · 10–14 years of experience leading product management initiatives across multiple platforms, products, or domains within large organizations, including product governance, portfolio level delivery, and people leadership of Product Managers.
   





 · Strong ability to align domain\-level product strategies, roadmaps, and prioritization with business objectives, customer outcomes, and enterprise platform considerations to deliver measurable impact.
   





 · Deep understanding of operationalizing product governance, outcome measurement, and decision controls, including OKRs, prioritization frameworks, roadmap discipline, and documentation standards.
   





 · Experience building and scaling product management capability through standardized practices, shared frameworks, tooling, and coaching to improve consistency and execution maturity.
   





 · Ability to interpret portfolio\-level product and delivery signals, including roadmap health, dependency risks, outcome performance, customer feedback, and platform stability, and take corrective action.
   




 Skilled at identifying product, delivery, and portfolio risks, assessing trade\-offs, and shaping recommendations that balance customer impact, strategic priorities, platform health, and delivery timelines.
   

  

  


**Minimum:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
   




**Preferred:** 
 Master’s degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and/or relevant certifications in Product Management, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Lean, Design Thinking, OKRs

 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration.  Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.

title: SENIOR MANAGER, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
description:
**About Team**
 Inventory \& Merch Tech is the engineering backbone of Walmart's Inventory \& Merchandising organization, spanning pricing, cost management, supplier, item, and inventory platforms that support 10,000\+ stores and Walmart's global supply chain. Our team delivers a single, unified experience for Walmart’s supplier community across all channels, covering Tier 1 capabilities end to end. Our goal is to dramatically scale assortment while improving supplier efficiency. We operate with high autonomy, a strong engineering culture, and a bias toward clean, principle\-based design over quick patches.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Define and own the technical roadmap and end\-to\-end delivery for merchant\- and associate\-facing pricing, assortment, and promotion applications.
   

  

 Lead and direct large\-scale, complex, cross\-functional projects, translating requirements into technical solutions and directing execution across teams.
   

  

 Stay hands\-on: develop design artifacts such as proof of concepts and prototypes, write and review code and oversee software design and unit test coverage.
   

  

 Build and maintain cloud\-native, resilient services using Java/Spring, Kafka, Cosmos DB, and REST/GraphQL APIs across Azure, GCP, and internal cloud platforms, with a React front end.
   

  

 Hire, develop, and retain a strong team of software engineers, owning performance management, career growth, and promotions.
   

  

 Own cloud cost discipline for your team's services, balancing performance and reliability against spend.
   

  

 Hold the team to a high engineering bar: strong CI/CD, automated testing, and security standards; automate where it pays off rather than by default.
   

  

 Partner with product, program, and project managers on plans, dependency tracking, and hand\-offs; communicate status, risks, and issues clearly to stakeholders and senior leadership.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
 Engineering degree (B.E./B.Tech./M.S.) in any discipline; Computer Science preferred.
   

  

 12\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including 5\+ years leading Agile/Scrum teams.
   

  

 Strong hands\-on track record in Java/Spring and modern front\-end development (React or equivalent).
   

  

 Deep expertise in architecture and design patterns, cloud\-native microservices, and event\-driven systems (Kafka or similar).
   

  

 Production experience on at least one major public cloud (Azure or GCP).

title: IBP 09 - Demand Planning

 The IBP Demand Planning \- Digital Product Owner will be a critical member of the global IBP digital product management team and local market teams. The IBP Demand Planning \- Digital Product Owner owns the technical solution delivery of continuous improvement for PepsiCo IBP tool with a focus on demand planning and forecasting components, including both functional and technical aspects. This includes deploying the global IBP template and local market configuration for the PepsiCo IBP Tool. The IBP Demand Planning \- Digital Product Owner will have to adapt to the dynamic needs of the business and ensure IBP tool is positioned to drive optimal business value. This includes balancing the development of a global digital product vs. local market needs.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 



 •Own and lead the continuous improvement and optimization of the Demand Planning and Forecasting digital capability of PepsiCo IBP tool in a local market, covering both technical and functional aspects.
 



 •Collaborate in fit\-gap sessions to refine and document the evolving future\-state design of Demand Planning and Forecasting process for the local markets.
 



 •Support ongoing analysis and iterative refinement of Demand Analysis and Forecasting working with Data Science to validate hypothesis, fine tune forecast engine configurations, identify key demand drivers by channel and optimize forecasting levels.
 



 •Define \& document the evolving functional design to ensure its accurate representation in functional specification for the demand planning and forecasting tool working closely with planning team, data science team, and consulting partners.
 



 •Support Data and Analytics team to ensure all data objects (GDO’s), including demand drivers, are defined, documented, and meet all business requirements
 



 •Continuously identify and address business and user requirements to improve processes within planning system, system’s architecture and respective digital capabilities.
 



 •Partner with the Data and Analytics team to refine and validate all data objects (GDOs), including demand drivers, ensuring they remain aligned with business needs.
 



 •Own and manage the iterative digital product roadmap, prioritizing enhancements and new features for the market in collaboration with Global IBP product managers/CoE.
 



 •Manage and improve cross\-workstream dependencies in partnership with Supply Planning and IBP Forums teams.
 



 •Ensure the ongoing delivery of high\-quality products, driving a culture of continuous improvement and excellence.
 



 •Demonstrate a passion for ongoing enhancement and optimization in product digital design and delivery.
 



  





 Qualifications
 



 •7\+ years of deployment and/or continuous development of Demand Planning and Forecasting digital tools and capabilities leveraging industrial standards such as o9 (preferable) or SAP IBP or similar ones.
 



 •7\+ years of digital product management experience continuously refining strategic product roadmaps and working with cross\-functional teams in a highly matrixed environment preferred.
 



 •Experience of managing evolving technical and functional design direction, incorporating user feedback and performance data, reflecting and maintaining respective changes in functional specifications.
 



 •Experience in leading and delivering through external partners.
 



 •Understanding data analytics, forecasting models (time\-series, driver\-based Machine Learning) and experience iterating models post deployment to improve accuracy will be a plus.
 



 •Proven experience in refining and optimizing digital products throughout the lifecycle, including ongoing iterations and enhancements, proven experience of using Agile and DevOps practices in product development.
 



 •Bachelor’s degree required; degree in quantitative or engineering related field preferred.
 



  





 Skills, Abilities, Knowledge:
 



 •Experience working with SAP and O9 required.
 



 •Excellent organizational and problem\-solving skills, with a focus on identifying improvement opportunities and making incremental changes.
 



 •Adaptable and flexible mindset to effectively respond to changing needs and drive improvements in a dynamic environment
 



 •Strong leadership, organizational and interpersonal skills; capable of managing trade\-offs.
 



 Additional qualifications that will make you stand out for this position:
 



 •Understands both the engineering and business side of the digital products released.
 



 •Places the user in the center of decision making.
 



 •Teams up and collaborates for speed, agility, and innovation.
 



 •World\-class organization and accountability.
 



 •Operates effectively in matrix relationships across organizational barriers.

title: TPM/RGM Practice SME
description:
TPM \& RGM Practice SME
   

  

**About The Role**
 Cognizant’s Industry Solutions Group (ISG) is seeking a senior TPM \& RGM Practice SME for the Consumer Goods practice. This individual will serve as Cognizant’s primary domain authority for Trade Promotion Management and Revenue Growth Management — driving pre\-sales solutioning, building platform alliances, representing Cognizant at industry forums, and providing functional advisory support on client engagements.
   

  

 Primary platform focus: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM (first preference) and XTEL TPM/RGM (second preference).
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Domain \& Solutioning Leadership
   

  

* Serve as the TPM/RGM domain authority across Cognizant’s Consumer Goods practice — designing end\-to\-end solution architectures covering trade planning, fund management, promotion execution, deduction management, and RGM analytics.
* Lead client solution design workshops and discovery sessions, driving alignment between business objectives (volume, margin, trade ROI) and platform capabilities.


 Pre\-Sales \& Bid Support
   

  

* Lead RFP/RFI responses as the primary TPM/RGM domain voice — authoring solution narratives, effort models, and PoC demonstrations for Salesforce CG Cloud and XTEL engagements.
* Collaborate with Sales and Delivery teams on pursuit strategy and competitive positioning; build and maintain reusable solution accelerators, proposal templates, and reference architectures.


 Thought Leadership \& Practice Development
   

  

* Publish whitepapers, point\-of\-view papers, and industry blogs on TPM/RGM trends, platform innovations, and CPG commercial technology; represent Cognizant at conferences and speaking engagements.
* Build and contribute to Cognizant’s TPM/RGM CoE — defining best practices, developing delivery playbooks and reusable assets, and mentoring junior consultants within the Consumer Goods practice.


 Alliance \& Partnership Management
   

  

* Serve as Cognizant’s primary relationship manager with key TPM/RGM platform partners — Salesforce CG Cloud, XTEL, and relevant ISVs — nurturing joint GTM engagement, co\-sell pipeline, and aligned solution roadmaps.
* Track partner roadmaps and identify partnership opportunities with CPG ecosystem players (o9, Anaplan, BluePlanner) to extend Cognizant’s TPM/RGM service portfolio; develop joint collateral and partner sales plays.


 Industry Forum Participation \& External Engagement
   

  

* Represent Cognizant at CPG technology conferences and industry forums (Salesforce Consumer Goods Summit, CGT events, XTEL user groups); deliver presentations and panel discussions on trade transformation and AI\-driven RGM.
* Engage analyst communities (Gartner, Forrester, IDC) to position Cognizant’s capabilities; build an external professional network across CPG trade marketing and technology communities to generate leads and surface new service opportunities.


 Techno\-Functional Lead — Customer Project Support
   

  

* Serve as senior functional advisor on select engagements — providing domain expertise during blueprint, fit\-gap, and go\-live phases without owning day\-to\-day workstream delivery.
* Act as the functional escalation point for delivery teams — resolving complex design decisions and conducting periodic quality reviews of solution documents and test plans.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
 Domain \& Technical Skills
   

  

* Deep functional expertise in TPM (trade planning, fund management, promotion execution, settlement, deduction management, post\-event analytics) and RGM (pricing strategy, pack\-price architecture, mix management, net revenue optimization).
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM (primary) — account planning, fund configuration, promotion lifecycle, deduction management, and MuleSoft integration patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with XTEL TPM/RGM (second preference) — trade fund setup, promotion planning, claims processing, and SAP/Oracle ERP integration architecture.
* Experience on at least 2 full\-cycle TPM/RGM implementations; proficiency in delivery artifacts (BRDs, fit\-gap documents, configuration workbooks, UAT scripts) and platform partner/alliance engagement.


 Pre\-Sales \& Consulting Skills
   

  

* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills — able to influence VP/Director\-level stakeholders; proven track record contributing to and winning CPG/Consumer Goods RFPs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-structuring skills; ability to translate business challenges into platform solutions and produce high\-quality proposals, PoVs, and solution collateral.

 Dimension
   

  

 Requirement
   

  

 Total Experience
   

  

 12–15 years in IT Delivery, consulting or CPG domain
   

  

 TPM/RGM Domain
   

  

 6\+ years in Trade Promotion or Revenue Growth Management
   

  

 Techno\-Functional Lead
   

  

 4\+ years leading functional workstreams on TPM/RGM platform implementations

title: Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**About Workhall** 




 Workhall is a bootstrapped low\-code / no\-code enterprise workflow platform. We help large organisations model complex operations as configurable data structures, workflows, and reports, without the cost and drag of bespoke custom development. Today we serve 20\+ enterprise customers across India, Australia, and the Americas, in industries ranging from manufacturing, food and beverage, construction, trade, and private capital.
 



**About the role** 




 You will be the technical backbone that turns the Workhall platform into a working enterprise application. Sitting inside the professional services team, you own requirements gathering, solution design, solve the hard data\-modelling and integration problems that complex customers bring, and act as the deep technical reference point for our implementation partners.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on solutioning role for someone who is equally comfortable whiteboarding an architecture and configuring the platform themselves. You are not just advising from the sidelines. You design, you build, and you set the standard others follow.
 



**What you will do** 





 Solution design and architecture
 



* Own end\-to\-end solution design on the platform: datalists, workflows, roles and permissions, reports, and the expression logic that ties them together.
* Translate ambiguous enterprise requirements into robust, scalable, maintainable configurations rather than one\-off hacks.
* Make and defend data\-modelling decisions, including denormalization and relationship patterns, with an eye on performance and long\-term maintainability on a document\-database platform.




 Build and delivery
 



* Configure and build complex applications.
* Design and implement integrations between Workhall and external enterprise systems.
* Own the hardest technical parts of an implementation, and unblock delivery teams when they hit the limits of the platform or the data model.




 Customer and stakeholder engagement
 



* Run technical discovery workshops with enterprise customers, shape the application, and communicate trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor through an implementation, from design through go\-live and stabilisation.




 Partner enablement and quality
 



* Enable, review, and raise the quality bar for implementation partners so delivery stays consistent as we scale.
* Define reusable patterns, templates, and technical standards that the wider delivery ecosystem can adopt.




 What we are looking for
 



* Experience. 3 to 6 years in enterprise software implementation, solution consulting, or technical delivery, including meaningful time on low\-code / no\-code, BPM, or workflow automation platforms.
* Data modelling. Strong data\-modelling instincts and comfort with document or NoSQL databases; MongoDB experience is a clear advantage.
* Platform depth. Ability to reason about workflow logic, conditional expressions, and integrations from first principles, not just by copying prior examples.
* Communication. Customer\-facing maturity: you can run a workshop, defend a design decision, manage expectations, and say no well.
* Ownership. A track record of owning the technically hardest part of a project and getting it live.




 Nice to have
 



* Familiarity with LCNC platform, API design, scripting, or integration middleware.




 Why join us
 



* Ownership. Real ownership. We are a lean, bootstrapped team, so your work ships and your judgement counts from week one.
* Depth. Hard, interesting problems. Modelling messy enterprise operations into clean, reusable software is genuinely difficult and genuinely rewarding.
* Range. Breadth of exposure. You will work across regulated industries and global markets, not a single narrow use case.
* Leverage. A platform with leverage. What you build once serves many customers and many verticals.

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI\-native era? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?

Join Accenture Technology Strategy \& Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C\-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI\-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI\-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.

 Technology Strategy \& Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.

As part of this high\-performing team, you will help organizations move from experimentation with AI coding tools to enterprise\-wide AI Native SDLC transformation. These are some of the initiatives you will support:
   

  

**AI Native SDLC Strategy and Roadmap:** 
 Assess current SDLC maturity, AI readiness, engineering productivity, application landscape assessment for AI driven delivery, toolchain landscape and delivery bottlenecks; define target\-state AI Native SDLC vision and pragmatic adoption roadmap

 Diagnose developer experience, flow of work, quality gates, release throughput, automation levels, technology debt, test coverage, knowledge fragmentation and value leakage across large engineering organizations

 Identify and prioritize AI and agentic use cases across requirements, backlog, architecture, design, coding, refactoring, testing, code review, security, release, documentation and run/operate interfaces; segment applications and teams where adoption makes business and technology sense

 Design target\-state engineering operating model considering AI native software delivery and help organization transition to new operating model

 Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps, investment choices, vendor strategy and scale\-up plan for enterprise\-wide AI Native SDLC adoption
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a visionary leader in Technology Strategy and Software Engineering Transformation who can help enterprises redefine how software is delivered in an AI\-native world. The role requires a senior consulting practitioner with strong understanding of enterprise SDLC, AI/ GenAI and Agentic architecture, engineering productivity, Agile, CI/CD and DevSecOps.
   

  

 The successful candidate will lead strategic advisory work across the AI Native SDLC transformation journey from current\-state maturity and AI readiness assessment to target\-state SDLC design, AI use case prioritization, platform and tooling strategy, value case development, benefits framework, roadmap definition and operating model change.
   

  

 The role requires executive presence, strong consulting capability and the ability to independently engage CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, engineering leaders and product/platform teams. The candidate should be able to shape compelling transformation narratives, facilitate senior stakeholder alignment and translate AI\-powered software delivery ambition into practical, business\-aligned decisions and measurable outcomes.

* Define target\-state AI Native SDLC ambition and strategy across all stages of fotware delivery and software maintenance
* Conduct application landscape assessment to Identify applications, products and teams best suited for AI\-native and agentic SDLC adoption based on value, feasibility, risk and readiness
* Identify, structure and prioritize AI and agentic use cases across the software delivery lifecycle, linking them to engineering productivity, quality and measurable outcomes

**Target\-State SDLC Design, Architecture and Tooling Strategy**

* Advise clients on AI platform, toolchain and vendor strategy, including integration approach, security, data/IP considerations, cost and developer adoption

description:

 Our team builds high\-quality and innovative software to enable our customers to grow their revenues powered by the state\-of\-the\-art subscription management platform
 



  





**About the Team** 




 We own the core of Chargebee's billing platform: the mission\-critical system of record that 6,500 customers across the globe rely on to run billions of dollars in revenue.
 



 Our customers range from startups to global enterprises, across B2B and B2C, and diverse go\-to\-market motions including PLG, SLG, and reseller. All of them bill on the same core platform.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Staff Product Manager with a
 **platform mindset** 
 to own Billing and Subscription Management, one of Chargebee's most foundational product areas. You will lead the evolution of the core billing platform, making it more flexible, scalable, and intelligent.
 



 The work is a balance. You will support thousands of existing businesses with urgent, high\-stakes requirements, while simultaneously evolving the platform for AI\-native monetization models, reimagining billing workflows, and creating dramatically better customer experiences.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Shape the roadmap:** 
 Understand customer requirements, market needs, competitive movements, and emerging trends; synthesize these into clear themes that inform and prioritize the roadmap.
* **Drive cross\-functional execution:** 
 Core billing workflows span multiple modules and teams. Partner closely with Engineering, Design, and dependent squads to drive execution with clarity and alignment.
* **Make hard prioritization calls:** 
 Navigate competing priorities, make clear trade\-offs, and communicate decisions effectively with stakeholders.
* **Reimagine billing with AI:** 
 Drive innovation across core billing workflows by exploring what is now possible with AI and translating those possibilities into meaningful customer value.
* **Build for flexibility and scale:** 
 Understand complex billing scenarios and apply a platform mindset to ensure capabilities are designed to flexibly support the needs of a diverse customer base.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* **8\+ years of experience** 
 in B2B enterprise product management; experience with billing is highly desirable.
* **High agency:** 
 Operate as the product anchor for your charter, driving cross\-functional alignment and owning outcomes end to end.
* **Technical fluency:** 
 Understand system design concepts and APIs well enough to collaborate effectively with senior engineers and make architecture\-aware product decisions.
* **Collaborative mindset:** 
 Thrive in a highly collaborative environment and enjoy working across teams to solve complex problems.
* **AI\-first mindset:** 
 Excited by the productivity and process improvements that new AI tools can unlock for product management and product development.
* **Structured and data\-driven:** 
 Break down complex problems, go deep into the details, and make decisions grounded in data.



  





**Why This Role Matters**

title: Product Manager
description:
We are seeking a visionary and highly experienced Principal Product Manager / Senior Business Consultant to provide strategic leadership across our core health\-tech product portfolios. This individual will act as a senior leader responsible for shaping the overarching strategy, driving execution, and ensuring alignment across multiple high\-impact healthcare domains (such as core administrative processing, clinical data exchange, and member\-centric platforms). As a Principal, you will not own a single product feature but will be responsible for orchestrating value creation across the broader ecosystem. You will connect the dots between disparate enterprise initiatives, drive cohesive data and platform strategies, and mentor product managers to deliver solutions that meet the strategic goals of enGen and our health plan partners.
 



 Key Takeaway (Ideal Candidate Profile) The ideal candidate is a seasoned product strategist with deep expertise in the US payer/provider landscape. They excel at "connecting the dots" across complex enterprise platforms, driving overarching product vision, and influencing executive stakeholders to prioritize high\-value, scalable healthcare solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  





 Enterprise Product Strategy \& Vision (40%)
 



 • Portfolio\-Level Roadmap: Define and champion a unified strategic vision that connects roadmaps across various health\-tech domains, ensuring they collectively contribute to enterprise goals like operational efficiency, improved health outcomes, and seamless provider/member experiences.
 



 • Strategic Decision\-Making: Act as the ultimate decision\-maker on value sequencing and prioritization for large, cross\-domain initiatives. Make informed, data\-driven trade\-offs that balance short\-term client needs with long\-term platform scalability.
 



 • Innovation \& Market Research: Serve as the organization's thought leader on emerging trends in healthcare technology (including automation, advanced analytics, and interoperability). Champion innovative solutions and build compelling, quantitative business cases for new strategic investments. 2\. Cross\-Functional Orchestration \& Governance (35%)
 



 • Ecosystem Collaboration: Act as the primary orchestrator between siloed product pillars, engineering leaders, data architecture teams, and business stakeholders. Identify opportunities for reusable solutions (e.g., shared data connectors, enterprise APIs, common business rules) to eliminate redundancy and accelerate delivery.
 



 • Stakeholder Influence: Influence stakeholders at all levels, from health plan executives to engineering leads, without direct authority. Articulate complex technical and healthcare business concepts to build consensus and drive alignment across a matrixed organization.
 



 • Compliance \& Data Governance: Champion enterprise\-wide governance standards for data exchange, security, and ethical automation, ensuring all solutions are compliant with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, CMS mandates) and securely manage PHI/PII. 3\. Mentorship \& Team Enablement (25%)
 



 • Product Leadership Mentorship: Provide direct guidance, coaching, and mentorship to Product Managers, Owners, and Business Analysts. Elevate the team's ability to think strategically, prioritize for value, and execute agile methodologies effectively.
 



 • Best Practices Evangelism: Define and institutionalize product management best practices, particularly in the areas of data\-driven decision\-making, value\-based prioritization, and outcome\-oriented roadmapping.
 



 • Talent Development: Partner with leadership to identify skill gaps and develop talent within the product management organization, fostering a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence.
 



  





**Qualifications Required (Must\-Have):**




  





 • Extensive Experience: 12\+ years of progressive experience in product management, business consulting, or a related strategic role, with a significant portion dedicated to the US healthcare payer or health\-tech space.
 



 • Healthcare Domain Expertise: Deep subject matter expertise in broad healthcare domains such as health plan operations, claims processing ecosystems, clinical data integration, or provider network management.
 



 • Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to translate high\-level business objectives from health plan partners into a cohesive, multi\-product strategy and an actionable roadmap.
 



 • Technical \& Data Literacy: Strong working understanding of modern enterprise architecture, cloud\-based data platforms, and emerging automation/AI capabilities. Must be able to lead technical discussions and evaluate technology stack trade\-offs.
 



 • Data Analysis Mastery: Expert\-level ability to leverage data for strategic decision\-making, guide analysts, interpret complex operational datasets, and build ROI\-focused business cases.
 



 • Exceptional Influence: Demonstrated history of leading large digital transformation initiatives and influencing senior leadership in a complex, multi\-tenant environment. Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)
 



 • Experience leading legacy system modernization initiatives (e.g., migrating off mainframe/legacy platforms to modern cloud architectures).
 



 • Familiarity with national healthcare data standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7, X12\).
 



 • Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA), Healthcare Administration (MHA), or a related technical field.
 



  





**About enGen Global**




  





**enGen Global** 
 is an emerging global healthcare partner that delivers strategic innovation, expertise, and flexibility to its healthcare partners. Being a US healthcare conglomerate captive, we have direct access to deeper insights that help us accelerate our learning process and keeps us ahead of the curve. Thryve delivers next\-generation solutions that enable our healthcare partners to provide positive experiences to their consumers.
 



  





 Our global collaborative of healthcare, operations, and IT experts creates innovative and sustainable processes for our clients, which keeps the ever\-evolving consumers engaged and assists them in managing the future of their healthcare better. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Thryve is an equal opportunity employer and places a high value on integrity, diversity, and inclusion in the organization. We do not discriminate based on any protected attribute.

title: Product Owner International
description:
**About ENBD** 




  





 Emirates NBD is a market leader across the MENAT (Middle East, North Africa and Türkiye) region with a presence in 13 countries, serving over 9 million customers. Emirates NBD is the leading financial services brand in the UAE with a Brand value of approximately USD 4 billion. We serve our customers and help them realise their financial objectives through a range of banking products and services including retail banking, corporate \& institutional banking, Islamic banking, investment banking, private banking, asset management, global markets and treasury, and brokerage operations. We also operate Liv, the lifestyle digital bank by Emirates NBD. With over half a million users, it continues to be the fastest\-growing digital bank in the region.

 As a Product Owner International at Emirates NBD, your role is to define the product vision, prioritizing the roadmap to "Set the Pace" in the regional market, and ensuring the delivery of world\-class Service Excellence. * Define and communicate the product vision and strategy for Emirates NBD KSA, Egypt and India

**Key Responsibilities** 



* Prioritize features and enhancements based on user feedback, business value, regulatory constraints, performance data and market trends.
* Create, manage, and prioritize the product backlog

* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure the backlog reflects current priorities and measurable business objectives.
* Work closely with UX/UI designers to create intuitive and engaging experiences for liabilities.
* Monitor funnel performance and customer behavior metrics, identify drop\-offs, and drive improvement initiatives.

* Minimum of bachelor’s degree preferably in business studies or technology.

 \- Understanding principles of good UX design.
 



 \- Knowledge of user journey mapping.
 



 \- Familiarity with wireframing and prototyping tools.
 


* Basic Understanding of Mobile Development:



 \- Familiarity with iOS and Android platforms.
 



 \- Understanding of mobile app development lifecycle.
 



 \- Knowledge of APIs and integrations.
 


* Communication and Collaboration Tools:



 \- Tools like Slack, Microsoft Teams.
 



 \- Documentation tools like Confluence.
 


* Tools like Sketch, Figma, Adobe XD, or InVision
* Creating mockups and interactive prototypes.



  





**There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.** 




 We’re one of the region’s most recognisable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.
 



  





 At ENBD, we encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for positions that match their skills and capabilities.

title: Consulting Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 This consulting analyst role focuses on delivering data driven insights and solution recommendations for global clients in the devices domain while working in a hybrid day shift model with no travel expectation. The analyst will collaborate across business and technology teams to design analytical approaches document findings and support implementation that improves device lifecycle performance optimizes operations and strengthens client value through measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive structured discovery sessions with client and internal stakeholders to understand current device related business processes pain points and strategic goals and translate these inputs into clearly documented consulting problem statements that guide subsequent analysis and solution design.
* Develop detailed analytical frameworks for evaluating device product performance customer usage trends and operational metrics and synthesize complex quantitative findings into practical recommendations that enable clients to improve efficiency reduce risk and enhance end user experience.
* Prepare clear and comprehensive consulting deliverables including business requirement documents current state and future state process descriptions and solution option analyses ensuring that each artifact is logically organized consistent and tailored to the needs of both business and technical audiences.
* Collaborate closely with cross functional teams in a hybrid work environment to validate assumptions refine solution hypotheses and ensure alignment between proposed device domain solutions and the client roadmap while maintaining timely communication and meticulous documentation of decisions and action items.
* Conduct impact assessments and feasibility analyses for proposed device oriented initiatives covering process changes system enhancements and data integration needs and present concise summaries that highlight business value implementation complexity and key dependencies to support informed decision making.
* Support configuration and implementation of selected solutions by providing detailed functional input reviewing test scenarios and tracing requirements to delivered features thereby helping project teams confirm that device domain objectives and user expectations are fully met during deployment.
* Design meaningful performance indicators and reporting views that monitor device related operations customer outcomes and service quality and work with data and technology colleagues to validate that metrics are accurate timely and actionable for ongoing client management.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions that walk stakeholders through analysis results recommended solutions and implementation plans encouraging candid feedback and incorporating relevant insights to strengthen client confidence and long term adoption of consulting outputs.
* Document consulting methodologies reusable templates and lessons learned from device domain engagements in an accessible format enabling the wider organization to leverage proven approaches increase consistency of delivery and accelerate future projects for multinational clients.
* Apply strong problem solving skills and structured thinking on a daily basis to break down ambiguous device related business challenges into manageable components evaluate alternative solution paths and recommend options that balance innovation cost effectiveness and operational practicality.
* Coordinate day shift work activities and hybrid collaboration routines to ensure timely progress on project milestones maintain effective communication across onsite and remote participants and uphold company standards for quality security and regulatory compliance in all consulting outputs.
* Contribute actively to continuous improvement initiatives by suggesting refinements to consulting processes proposing enhancements to analytical tools and sharing device market observations that help the company better anticipate client needs and strengthen its role in advancing responsible technology use in society.
* Engage with domain research client case studies and internal knowledge repositories to stay current on emerging trends in devices and apply these insights to develop forward looking perspectives that help clients design more sustainable reliable and user centered solutions.


**Qualifications**
* Bring between four and six years of experience in consulting analysis business analysis or a closely related discipline demonstrating a consistent track record of converting complex client requirements into clear documentation and practical solution recommendations for enterprise environments.
* Possess solid exposure to the devices domain such as consumer electronics medical devices or industrial equipment with the ability to understand lifecycle stages regulatory considerations and user behavior patterns and to incorporate this understanding into nuanced analysis and advisory work.
* Show strong proficiency in analytical and problem solving techniques including data interpretation process mapping and root cause analysis and be comfortable using productivity and reporting tools to produce high quality artifacts that support informed decision making by clients.
* Demonstrate excellent communication and collaboration capabilities suited to a hybrid work model including the capacity to run structured discussions capture meeting outcomes accurately and work effectively across diverse teams and cultures in a multinational organization without frequent travel.
* Exhibit familiarity with consulting or project delivery practices such as requirement elicitation change impact assessment test support and post implementation review and apply these practices consistently to maintain high quality outcomes across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Display a proactive learning mindset with readiness to build deeper expertise in devices data analysis and consulting methods and show commitment to ethical business practice and inclusive teamwork that supports the company purpose of creating responsible and impactful technology solutions for global society.

**Job Summary**

Creates and establishes design standards and assurance processes for software, systems and applications development to ensure compatibility and operability of data connections, flows and storage requirements. title: CAPEX Excellence specialist
description:
**Support CAPEX planning, execution and reporting**
 Join NKT in a role that connects CAPEX governance, system support, and business improvement across an international organization. You will own day\-to\-day support, adoption, and continuous improvement of the CAPEX tool, helping teams work with consistent data, reliable reporting, and clear processes. This is a valuable opportunity to contribute to the green transition by supporting investment decisions across the business. Are you motivated by combining systems, process standards, and user support in one role?
   

  

**Keep CAPEX operations stable and consistent**
 In this role, you will act as the main business contact for the CAPEX tool and related process standards. You will support users, coordinate incidents and improvement requests with, and help maintain common templates, workflows, and reporting standards. The role also includes governance of master data, backlog prioritization, UAT coordination, and communication around releases and changes. You will work closely with CAPEX project managers, finance, procurement, IT, and process owners to support reliable planning, execution, and tracking across sites and functions.
   

  

**Your Responsibility Will Be To**
* Provide first\-line functional support and coordinate further support when needed
* Maintain user guides, SOPs, and training materials
* Govern usage standards, workflows, and documentation requirements
* Support reports and dashboards with consistent KPI definitions
* Coordinate UAT, releases and backlog priorities


 You will work across manufacturing sites and shared functions, in close collaboration with CAPEX project managers, site controllers, procurement and IT.
   

  

**Structured communicator with a clear quality focus**
 We are looking for someone who is service\-minded, and organized, with a practical approach to user support and process governance. You communicate clearly with both end users and management, work carefully with documentation and change control, and are comfortable balancing business needs with standard ways of working. The right person is initiative\-taking, detail\-oriented, and able to move issues forward while keeping compliance, auditability, and data quality in focus.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* 5\+ years of experience in CAPEX controlling, project execution, PMO, finance, or a similar area using CAPEX, ERP, or project portfolio tools
* Experience translating business needs into system requirements and supporting UAT, training, and change management
* Good understanding of data structures, reporting, and integrations with finance or ERP systems
* Experience acting as system or product owner
* Training or certification in ERP/PM systems or project management


**Help improve investment quality for a greener future**
 NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are motivated to establish gender diversity at NKT and encourage all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long\-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.
   

  

 In this role, you will be part of a collaborative international setting where you can broaden your skills in CAPEX governance, systems, reporting, and change processes. You will work with colleagues across business functions and sites, contribute to continuous improvement, and support reliable investment planning that matters to NKT’s ongoing journey and the wider green transition.
   

  

 “This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting systems, process standards, and user needs to create reliable CAPEX planning and reporting across the business,” says Hiring Manager, Karim Damiani
   

  

 Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
   

  

 We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 30th September 2026\. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e\-mail.
   

  

 We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
   

  

 Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
   

  

**About NKT**
*NKT connects a greener world with high\-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low\-, medium\- and high\-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3\.6 billion in 2025\. We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com*

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
As a Software Engineering Manager within MS TECH Order Fulfillment, you will provide strategic product and technical leadership, along with hands\-on expertise, to build industry\-leading products. You are a systems thinker capable of driving large\-scale transformations that maximize value for Ford, our Dealers, and our customers. The role combines high\-level strategy, including product vision, AI/ML use\-case portfolio, data strategy, and technical roadmaps, with disciplined execution to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, explainable, and highly available solutions in a global environment.
   

  

**Technical Leadership \& Vision**
* Serve as the primary technical authority for the Order Generation product suite, defining the evolution of the technology stack, data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural patterns.
* Lead cross\-functional teams through complex integrations, managing dependencies across the broader Order Fulfillment ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability.
* Translate high\-level business requirements into actionable technical strategies that align with Ford enterprise standards.


**AI/ML Product Strategy \& Innovation**
* Define and execute an AI/ML and data analytics product strategy that converts priority business requirements into a sequenced portfolio of intelligent capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI/ML opportunities across forecasting, order generation, decision support, anomaly detection, optimization, and workflow automation using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption criteria.
* Lead the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI/ML products from discovery, business\-case development, experimentation, and MVP validation through industrialization, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, usable, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
* Establish outcome\-based product metrics, experimentation methods, model performance targets, and adoption measures; use evidence and customer feedback to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Monitor emerging technologies, including generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, advanced analytics, optimization, and intelligent automation, and determine where they can create differentiated business value.
* Drive build, buy, or partner assessments and develop scalable patterns for reusable AI/ML services, data products, model APIs, and decision intelligence capabilities.


**Product Strategy \& Delivery**
* Partner with business stakeholders to define and execute a multi\-year product vision and roadmap focused on optimized order forecasting and generation.
* Champion an iterative, Agile delivery model, prioritizing the delivery of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and maintaining a high\-velocity release cadence.
* Apply Human\-Centered Design (HCD) principles to ensure technical solutions solve real\-world problems for Dealers and customers.
* Create launch and adoption plans that include operational readiness, user training, change management, benefit tracking, and feedback loops.


**Data, Model \& MLOps Excellence**
* Ensure AI/ML solutions are supported by trusted, governed, discoverable, and fit\-for\-purpose data, with clear ownership, lineage, quality controls, and access patterns.
* Guide the implementation of robust MLOps and LLMOps practices covering reproducible experimentation, model registry, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, and auditability.
* Define controls for model quality, explainability, bias and fairness evaluation, privacy, security, human oversight, and responsible use throughout the product lifecycle.
* Balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, latency, cost, reliability, and business usability when selecting models and architectures.


**Engineering \& Operational Excellence**
* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, including Test\-Driven Development (TDD), robust CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive a culture of Full Lifecycle Ownership, where the team is responsible for the design, security, deployment, and operational health of its services.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for system health, code quality, delivery velocity, model performance, data quality, adoption, and realized business value.


**Architectural Design**
* Architect and oversee the development of cloud\-native, microservices\-based systems designed for global scale, multi\-tenancy, and high\-performance transactional processing.
* Design interoperable data and AI architectures that support batch and real\-time inference, event\-driven workflows, APIs, observability, and secure integration with enterprise platforms.


**People Leadership \& Talent Development**
* Cultivate a high\-performing, diverse team of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers through active coaching, mentorship, and career pathing.
* Foster a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning, utilizing blameless retrospectives and regular feedback loops to drive team growth.

title: Consulting Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 Consulting Manager role in a global organization focused on delivering strategic and operational consulting services to property and casualty insurance clients requiring eight to ten years of experience in this domain working in a hybrid day shift model with no travel and driving impactful solutions that improve profitability customer experience and risk management for insurers and the communities they serve.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead complex consulting engagements for property and casualty insurance clients to design and implement solutions that improve underwriting accuracy claims efficiency and overall operational performance.
* Drive the development of client specific strategies that optimize product portfolios pricing approaches and risk selection while aligning with regulatory requirements and market trends.
* Coordinate cross functional project teams including business analysts and technical specialists to ensure that requirements for policy administration rating and claims systems are clearly defined and delivered effectively.
* Analyze current insurance processes data flows and system landscapes to identify inefficiencies and recommend practical improvements that reduce cycle times and operational costs.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to prioritize transformation initiatives build realistic roadmaps and secure consensus on scope timelines and expected business outcomes.
* Prepare detailed business cases that quantify financial benefits customer impact and risk mitigation for proposed changes in underwriting claims handling and policy servicing.
* Guide the configuration and adoption of core insurance platforms and tools by translating business needs into solution options that are feasible and sustainable.
* Monitor engagement progress through structured status reporting risk tracking and issue resolution to ensure deliverables are completed on time and meet agreed quality standards.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions that help clients refine target operating models and define clear roles responsibilities and handoffs across distribution underwriting and claims functions.
* Develop reusable consulting frameworks best practices and knowledge assets focused on property and casualty insurance to enhance consistency and quality across projects.
* Provide coaching and day to day guidance to consulting team members on insurance concepts analytical approaches and client communication to strengthen overall delivery capability.
* Engage with internal business development teams to support proposal responses by shaping solution narratives estimating effort and articulating value for property and casualty prospects.
* Ensure that all consulting recommendations adhere to applicable insurance regulations and corporate governance standards while promoting ethical practices and fair customer outcomes.


**Qualifications**
* Possess a strong foundation in property and casualty insurance operations including underwriting policy administration billing and claims with hands on experience delivering transformation projects.
* Demonstrate deep familiarity with insurance rating concepts risk assessment techniques and portfolio performance analytics to support fact based client recommendations.
* Show proficiency in using analytical tools and structured problem solving methods to interpret insurance data diagnose root causes and propose actionable improvements.
* Exhibit solid consulting skills such as stakeholder management workshop facilitation and presentation development with the ability to communicate complex topics in clear terms.
* Apply practical knowledge of core insurance technology platforms and integration patterns to bridge business requirements with feasible system solutions.
* Utilize strong documentation and report writing capabilities to produce clear deliverables including process maps requirements specifications and executive summaries.
* Demonstrate effective collaboration skills in hybrid work environments by balancing on site client interaction with remote coordination and ensuring continuity across channels.
* Display sound organizational and time management skills to handle multiple parallel assignments while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.
* Show awareness of emerging trends in property and casualty insurance such as digital claims telematics and advanced analytics to keep solutions future ready.
* Value inclusive and ethical business practices that promote fair treatment of policyholders and support the broader social role of insurance in protecting communities.
* Prefer prior experience in management consulting or advisory roles within insurers or service providers that focus on property and casualty lines.
* Embrace continuous learning through industry forums certifications and internal training to maintain up to date expertise in insurance and consulting disciplines.

 Are you a hands\-on product manager with strong technical leader understanding for creating exceptional developer tools and infrastructure? Global Customs is looking for a Product Manager who embraces Lean, Agile and Human Centered Design practices to deliver innovative software products for Ford Motor Company. As our Developer Enablement Leader, you will be instrumental in shaping the future of our Customs IT practices. You'll lead the charge in evaluating, implementing, and driving the adoption of cutting\-edge technologies and best practices – from CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks to monitoring solutions. Your work will directly empower our software engineers to build high\-quality software faster and more efficiently. You will also play a key role in enhancing our internal development platform, ensuring it provides a robust and scalable foundation for all our teams. If you possess deep expertise in DevOps principles, modernization through Google Cloud adoption, a relentless drive for automation, and a proven history of building and scaling developer infrastructure, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Fuel Developer Productivity:** 
 Your primary mission will be to empower our development teams to be as productive and efficient as possible.
   

  

**This Means**
**Driving Product Strategy:** 
 Owning the product vision and roadmap to ensure Customs IT delivers maximum business value.
   

  

* Product Discovery: Engaging customers and business stakeholders to uncover needs, validate problems, and identify opportunities before committing engineering investment.
* Roadmap Prioritization: Defining and prioritizing the product roadmap based on customer impact, strategic alignment, and delivery feasibility.
* Stakeholder Prioritization: Balancing and negotiating competing requests across NA, EU, and IMG stakeholders to focus the team on the highest\-value work.
* Backlog Grooming: Owning and continuously refining the product backlog, writing clear epics/stories, and ensuring readiness for sprint planning.
* Business Value Articulation: Building the business case for initiatives and clearly communicating expected ROI, cost savings, and developer productivity gains to leadership.


**Orchestrating Innovation:** 
 Conduct experimentation and build products that would accelerate developer flow.
   

  

**Cloud\-Native Empowerment:** 
 Playing a vital role in enabling developers to build and deploy applications seamlessly on our chosen cloud platform (GCP, OpenShift, GKE), making the cloud a natural extension of their development workflow.
   

  

**Inner Source Evangelist:** 
 Collaborating with teams to cultivate a culture of knowledge sharing and innovation by encouraging developers to contribute to internal customs projects and collaborate across team boundaries – NA, EU, and IMG.
   

  

**Promote New Products with AI:** 
 Conduct experimentation and build products that would accelerate developer flow. Design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered solutions for code acceleration and tech debt reduction, leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG).
   

  

**DevSecOps Champion:** 
 Driving the adoption of DevSecOps principles and practices, embedding security into every stage of the development lifecycle.
   

  

**Lead and Inspire:** 
 You'll be a great leader, mentor, and advocate for our development teams. This means:
   

  

**Providing Expert Guidance:** 
 Sharing your deep knowledge on a variety of topics related to developer tooling, best practices, and emerging technologies.
   

  

**Lead the Code Reviews:** 
 Leading \& Providing constructive feedback on code quality, architectural alignment, and adherence to best practices.
   

  

**Staying Ahead of the Curve:** 
 Keeping your finger on the pulse of the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in the developer tooling space.
   

  

**Championing Continuous Improvement:** 
 Continuously seeking ways to improve our platform, processes, and the overall developer experience.
   

  

**Collaborate and Communicate:** 
 You'll be a critical bridge between development teams and other stakeholders, ensuring everyone is aligned and working towards a common vision. This means:
   

  

**Working Closely with Teams:** 
 Collaborating with development teams, architects, product managers, security teams, and the "Tools" team.
   

  

**Communicating Effectively:** 
 Explaining complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
   

  

**Presenting at Events:** 
 Sharing your knowledge and insights at team meetings, workshops, and conferences, inspiring others to embrace new technologies and best practices.
   

  

**Acting as a Liaison:** 
 Representing the needs of development teams to other departments, ensuring their voices are heard.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in project management \& software development \- with a focus on Java, Angular, and Spring Boot.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with Agile methodologies, including defining product vision and strategy, building product roadmaps, and creating and managing backlogs.
* A deep understanding of object\-oriented design principles and patterns.
* A proven track record of driving adoption of developer tools and best practices.
* A deep understanding in modern development tools (VS Code, IntelliJ with CoPilot assistance etc) and technologies (e.g., Git, Gradle, Tekton, Terraform, OpenShift / Kubernetes, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Cycode/ SAST \& FOSSA etc).
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP – Preferred, Azure/AWS – Nice to have).
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

**Additional Skills**
* Experience with developer enablement initiatives.

* Experience with microservices architecture.

**Key Skills**
